recipe_version.title: Lebanese Samke Harra: Spicy Tahini-Baked Cod with Bulgur Pilaf
recipe_version.description: Cod fillets spread with a sizzling garlic, red chile, Aleppo pepper, and cilantro topping, blanketed in lemony tahini sauce, and baked until bubbling and just flaking. Served over a toasty onion and tomato bulgur pilaf.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: cold, to loosen the tahini sauce

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.preparation: 2 grated for the sauce, 4 minced for the harra

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.preparation: finely chopped, plus leaves for garnish

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp harra, 2 tbsp pilaf, 1 tbsp dish

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp sauce, 1 tsp bulgur

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 400 F to preheat with a rack in the middle; it heats for the next 28 minutes while you prep and cook the toppings. Pat the cod dry and season with 1 tsp salt. Dice the onion; seed and chop the chiles; mince 4 garlic cloves and grate 2; chop the cilantro. Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, grated garlic, and 1/2 tsp salt, then whisk in the 1/2 cup cold water a little at a time until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Start the bulgur
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium. Cook the onion, stirring, until soft and golden at the edges, 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and bulgur for 1 minute, add 2 1/4 cups water and 1 tsp salt, bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat. The covered cooking and rest run inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the harra
steps.body: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Add the minced garlic and chiles and sizzle, stirring, until fragrant and just turning golden, 2 minutes. Stir in the Aleppo pepper and cumin for 30 seconds, then take off the heat and stir in the chopped cilantro.

steps.title: Bake the fish
steps.body: Brush the baking dish with 1 tbsp olive oil and lay in the cod. Spread the harra over the fillets and pour the tahini sauce over and around them. Bake in the preheated 400 F oven until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the cod is opaque, flaking, and 145 F, 15 to 18 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the bulgur and spoon it onto plates. Set a fillet with its sauce on each, scatter cilantro leaves, and serve with lemon wedges.
